{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern U.S. cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] 
{{recipesummary|category=Pie recipes|servings=10|time=2½ hours|difficulty=3}}

==Ingredients==

* 6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Half and Half|half-and-half]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] loosely-packed [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Corn Syrup|dark corn syrup]]
* ½ cup good [[Cookbook:Bourbon|bourbon]]
* 1⅓ cups [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]
* 2½ cups [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecan pieces]]
* [[Cookbook:Pastry Dough|Pastry dough]] for 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] pie (commercial or your own)

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|350°F]] (175°C).
# [[Cookbook:Beat|Beat]] eggs until yellow and creamy, in a large bowl.
# [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] in half-and-half, sugar, and syrup, until smooth.
# Stir in bourbon, chocolate chips, and pecans.
# [[Cookbook:Oil|Oil]] a [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform pan]] lightly.
# Roll out the pastry dough and press it into a pan, pressing out any air bubbles.
# Pour mixture into oiled springform pan.
# Put pie on a [[Cookbook:Cookie Sheet|baking sheet]] with a raised edge or border.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] until only the center is sightly jiggly, about 2 hours.
# Do not remove the pie from the mold until absolutely cooled, at least an hour.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Cool on a wire grid or rack for even cooling.
* Serve slightly warmed, or at room temperature.
* Very good with a dollop of [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] or [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]].
